Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier as chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds mentioned in document CHEMBL1862790. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc_chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require available structures. Return only rows where canonical_smiles is not null. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
